design.decision: Low [♠]s become trump winners before bidding, so bid more and plan to trump and cash [♠]s.
design.opponent: Revealed when a raised [♠] wins a trick it would have lost; opponents must hold their own high [♠]s back.
design.rationale: An uncommon enabler that changes who wins tricks: a bigger visible hand change than the commons, with every raised card still a [♠]. Would buy it before knowing the build, because more trump winners help every contract.
design.draftText: Opening: Raise every [♠] your team holds by three ranks
design.hooks: raise with a source filter (raise { amount, from: Filter }): raise only cards that match the filter; the same filter field already exists on become.

history.note: draft-uncommon: merged into ua-spade-raise, the same design (signature) from another cluster; the amount sweep decides the number.
